question: On 1st December 2020, which of the following states launched the scheme 'Orunodoi'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Orundoi or Arunodoi Scheme:

 
 
• It is a new scheme of the Government of **Assam launched on 2nd October 2020.**
 
• Under this scheme, **Monetary benefits have been envisaged for more than 24 lac poor households in the state.**
 
• The schematic benefit has been **enhanced from 830/- to Rs. 1000/ Wome**n.
 
• This is the** biggest ever scheme in Assam post-independence.**
 
• It will strengthen the role of the women as the money will be deposited in the bank accounts of the women of the families.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Assam:**

 
 
• **Chief Minister** - Hemant Biswa Sarma
 
• **Governor** - Jagdish Mukhi
 
• **Number of districts** - 33
 
• **Lok Sabha seats** - 14.
 
• **Rajya Sabha Seats** - 7.
